__prompts__.repo_name: Name of the new environment repository.
__prompts__.project_id: GCP Project ID where resources are created, Must supply answer.
__prompts__.domain_name: Base domain (e.g., myfancydomain.org) that you have setup delegate clouddns to control, You must supply answer.
__prompts__.gcp_user_account: an email address that has google account permissions in the GCP project to give GCP resources permsissions and will be used for letsencrypt certifactes. You must supply answer.
__prompts__.state_bucket: the name of the bucket you setup to track terraform state. Defaults to {project_id}-terraform-state.
__prompts__.pcg_bucket_name: the name of the bucket you setup to store PCG data. You must supply answer.
__prompts__.global_server: the domain name of the global server you are using. Defaults to global.{domain_name}.
__prompts__.materialize_datastack: the first datastack that you want to setup, and create a templated schedule for.  You must supply answer, but is easy to change later
__prompts__.health_annotation_align_volume: an aligned volume name that will be used by the annotaiton service for the liveliness probe
__prompts__.region: GCP region for regional resources (e.g., us-west1), depends where you want the cluster to be, default will work.
__prompts__.zone: GCP zone used in kube context and defaults (e.g., us-west1-b), depends on where you want cluster to be, default will work.
__prompts__.owner: Label used on resources; helpful for cost filtering. Default will work
__prompts__.local_environment_name: Environment name used for the cluster folder (e.g., api, staging, prod). Default will work
__prompts__.local_cluster_prefix: Short identifier used as cluster_prefix and DNS subdomain (e.g., apiv5), you might have several versions of a cluster from one environment, suggest to be clearly related to the local_environment_name. Default will work.
__prompts__.local_sql_instance_name: Cloud SQL Postgres instance name. Defaults to cave-{local_environment_name}. If migrating existing data, lookup the name you decided.
__prompts__.dns_zone: Cloud DNS managed zone name (e.g., cave), can leave default if you don't care.
__prompts__.bigtable_instance_name: Optional: Bigtable instance name for PyChunkedGraph (default pychunkedgraph). You must supply but this is the most common name
__prompts__.vpc_name_override: Optional: Name of vpc to utilize. If you aren't migrating let terraform name it based on other settings and leave blank
__prompts__.pcg_redis_name_override: Optional: Name of redis instance to store PCG meshing cache data.  Default will name it based on cluster_prefix and will work.
__prompts__.bigtable_google_project: Optional: if your PCG bigtable instance is in another project, the name of that project
__prompts__.sql_google_project: Optional: if you want the Cloud SQL instance in another project, the name of that project. Leave blank to use project_id. Only set this for a brand new deployment; it cannot be changed later without replacing the database.
__prompts__.skeleton_cache_cloudpath: Optional: if you have already setup a skeleton cache bucket, name of the path to that bucket. Note you need to uncomment this in the root.hcl file to utilize.
__prompts__.pcg_skeleton_cache_bucket_public_read: Optional: should the skeleton cache bucket be publically readable. false will work by default. If true, you need to uncomment in the root.hcl file.
__prompts__.docker_registry: Optional: Container registry for images (default docker.io/caveconnectome) is likely correct.
__prompts__.local_modules_repo: Optional: directory name of a terraform-google-cave checkout sitting next to your environments repo, to source modules from instead of the Terraform registry. Use this when you need a module variable that is not published yet: terragrunt passes inputs as TF_VAR_* and terraform silently ignores undeclared variables, so an older registry module drops the input without erroring. Leave blank to use the pinned registry versions.
__prompts__.cave_secret_name: Name of the Google Secret Manager secret containing the CAVE token. Defaults to {local_environment_name}-cave-token. You must manually create this secret before running terraform.
__prompts__.letsencrypt_email: Email for Let's Encrypt certificates. Defaults to your gcp_user_account value.
__prompts__.materialization_dump_bucket_name: Optional: GCS bucket name for materialization dumps. Leave blank if not needed.
__prompts__.materialization_upload_bucket_name: Optional: GCS bucket name for materialization uploads. Leave blank if not needed.
__prompts__.materialization_bucket_google_project: Optional: google project for the materialization dump and upload buckets. Leave blank to follow sql_google_project, which itself falls back to project_id, so the buckets sit with the database. A bucket's project cannot be changed later without destroying and recreating it.
